caption:
Most beginners only look at the fee on one trade. 0.1% feels like nothing.
But you pay it to buy and again to sell, and it repeats every trade. At 100 trades a month, fees alone take about 18% of your account.
Check your platform's fee page before your next trade, and count how many trades you really need.
Did you know fees add up this fast? Yes or no.

Education only. Not financial advice.
